title: Tate McRae releases "Housewife," the first single from her next album
excerpt: Tate McRae released "Housewife" on October 15 through RCA Records, marking her first new song in nearly a year and the lead single from her upcoming fourth studio album.
body:
Tate McRae released "Housewife" on October 15 through RCA Records, marking her first new song in nearly a year and the lead single from her upcoming fourth studio album.

The track arrives after the cycle around her 2025 album *So Close to What*, which included the singles "Sports Car," "It's OK I'm OK" and "Tit for Tat." McRae first teased the title during her Lollapalooza set on August 2, when the word appeared on screen. She formally announced the single on October 7 with artwork that showed her in a red bikini beside a baby stroller filled with cash, posed in front of a villa in the south of France.

"Housewife" flips the domestic image its title suggests. In the chorus McRae sings that she wants to "make a lot of money, be my own housewife," keeping romance optional rather than necessary. The song was written with Julia Michaels, Ryan Tedder, Jasper Harris, Pablo Díaz-Reixa and Grant Boutin. Tedder, Boutin and Harris produced it.

The accompanying video, directed by Pierre-Ange Carlotti and shot in the south of France, follows McRae through an estate, gardens and a yacht named Tati. She dances, lounges by a pool and moves through a relationship that grows increasingly strained. The film ends with her tossing a coin into a wishing well.

[youtube:DPEodkHzH-s]

Three days after the release, McRae performed "Housewife" at the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show in Los Angeles on October 18, placing the new song in front of a global audience almost immediately. On *The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon* she described the character as "a woman who can't be contained" and called the video shoot "so magical and so fun."

"Housewife" has already reached number one in Australia, Austria, Germany, Ireland and Norway, and entered the top ten in several other markets. It is McRae's first release of 2026 and the clearest signal yet of the direction her next album will take.
